object.description: Accepted, no test. With read-only mode off and an uncommitted change, change a file of the document from another program without activating the window, then Commit; repeat with the change made while the commit dialog is open, and with a change to a parent document's file. Expected: each commit is refused and the latest commit is unchanged. Control: a figure redrawn under MELLON-GUI-SRS-98 before the commit doesn't stop it.
